description: Fixed prompt set for qwen3.8-27b (vLLM) vs qwen3.8-flash-next (Strata). Change it only with a new results baseline.

prompts.title: Short chat
prompts.prompt: In three sentences, explain the difference between a Kubernetes Deployment and a StatefulSet, and say when you would pick each.

prompts.title: Coding task
prompts.prompt: Write a Python 3 function parse_quantity(s: str) -> float that converts Kubernetes resource quantities to a plain number: binary suffixes Ki Mi Gi Ti Pi Ei, decimal suffixes n u m k M G T P E, plain integers and decimals, and exponent forms such as 2e3. Raise ValueError on bad input. Then write a compact unittest.TestCase covering every suffix family, the exponent form and two invalid inputs. Return only one Python code block.

prompts.title: Reverse-engineering explanation
prompts.prompt:
Explain what this x86-64 function (System V ABI, Intel syntax) does. Give: the C prototype with argument roles, equivalent C code, what the 8-byte table at rdx is for, and a function that undoes the transformation.

decode:
    test    rsi, rsi
    je      .done
    xor     eax, eax
.loop:
    movzx   ecx, byte ptr [rdi+rax]
    mov     r8d, eax
    and     r8d, 7
    xor     cl, byte ptr [rdx+r8]
    rol     cl, 3
    mov     byte ptr [rdi+rax], cl
    inc     rax
    cmp     rax, rsi
    jne     .loop
.done:
    ret
